Summary

Mechanical Engineering student at Çankaya University (3rd year), focused on welding engineering (IWE pathway) and advanced manufacturing. Strong interest in armor steels, welding metallurgy, and defense production systems.

Currently on the International Welding Engineer (IWE) certification pathway — a globally recognized credential by the International Institute of Welding (IIW).

Investigating heat input effects and micro-crack formation mechanisms in high-hardness armor steels. Analyzing welding parameters and their influence on HAZ behavior and material integrity.
